name: Wardrobe validates only changed slots, so an active set does not block other transmogs (#11003, #8897)
contract: Extensions.dll ApplyPendingAppearances validates only the categories the player changed, then sends the
whole pending array in CMSG_APPLY_APPEARANCES (0x0697); unchanged slots carry the current active appearance.
APPLY_APPEARANCES_OK makes the client's current array its pending one, and SMSG_APPEARANCE_ACTIVE_INFO
(opcode 1690; word category+1) replaces both with the server's array. Appearances.dbc row 17650 is the
Hexflame Coven item set (category 55); its pieces 3162-3174 all have categories (1, 0, 0) and
ExpandItemSetAppearance stores them by InventoryType in slots 1-11, so shoulder appearance 3163 is active in
category 2. The server must send that expanded array after the apply, accept it back unchanged with a new
thrown appearance 12001 (category 12) instead of APPLY_APPEARANCES_INVALID_CATEGORY, keep shoulder 35
(category 2) chosen over a piece while the set stays selected instead of expanding the set again, and clear
the set's unchanged pieces, but not the player's own choices, when the set is removed. A relog reads
character_appearance back. CoA.UnlockLocalAppearanceCatalog collects every appearance, so the reports'
uncollected active slots cannot be fixtured; they take the same unchanged-slot path. Each save is an
asynchronous character transaction; the waits let one commit before the next, because the simulated-clock
harness runs several character database workers that do not keep their order.

steps.label: The client is told the set shoulders are active in category 2
Let the saved appearances commit before the next write
The weapon request receives one response
Unchanged set slots do not reject the new weapon appearance
Let the saved appearances commit before the next write
Changing a set slot is accepted
The client is told shoulders 35 are active in category 2
Let the saved appearances commit before the relog
The chosen shoulders replace the set piece in category 2
The set head piece stays in category 1
The thrown appearance is saved in category 12
The set selection stays in category 55
Removing the set clears its head piece
Removing the set keeps the chosen shoulders
Removing the set keeps the thrown appearance
